v2_allowed_triggers: new institutional regime break registered in external_facts
preregistered stratified bias test fails for the required consecutive-quarter count
L5 attribution shows persistently excessive statistical-factor contribution under a frozen threshold
a genuinely new PIT data source becomes available
forbidden_trigger: any alpha IC, backtest return, portfolio performance, or dissatisfaction with an alpha result

model_correction_path.allowed_trigger: a reproducible lineage or metric-coherence defect independent of alpha results
model_correction_path.required_action: issue a new risk_basis_id, retain the risk_set_version when membership is unchanged, rerun L1/G2/G3 and all basis-scoped semantic probes, and publish immutable supersession records
model_correction_path.current_registered_defect: sqrt-cap L1 orthogonalization consumed by structural-pit G3

upgrade_cost: recompute every alpha exposure under v2 and re-estimate every IC
mark all v1 IC conclusions superseded and never pool v1 and v2 results
do not reset research_attempt counts; maintain separate risk-set-scoped FDR views over the append-only ledger
do not move the holdout boundary
retain v1 artifacts and publish an immutable reconciliation
